title: Remove all user-uploaded photos and videos from backend and UI

requirements.text: Add backend deletion method to permanently remove user-uploaded media (images and videos) from blob storage and associated metadata from the posts data structure

quotes: User ke dwara upload ki Gai sari photos video
Uploaded media files ko backend se remove

acceptanceCriteria: Backend method accepts post ID or media identifier as parameter
Method deletes the blob data from storage
Method removes post metadata containing the media reference
Method returns success/error status
Only the post owner or admin can delete the media

requirements.text: Add delete button to each media post card in the feed and profile views that allows users to remove their uploaded photos and videos

quotes: UI se bhi unhein hata dena
Delete button har media item ke saath

acceptanceCriteria: Delete button appears on PostCard components for media posts
Button is only visible to the post owner or admins
Clicking delete button triggers confirmation dialog
Button uses appropriate icon (trash/delete)
Button is styled consistently with existing UI

requirements.text: Implement confirmation dialog before deleting media to prevent accidental deletion

quotes: Confirmation dialog accidental deletion se bachne ke liye

acceptanceCriteria: Dialog shows clear warning message about permanent deletion
Dialog has 'Cancel' and 'Delete' buttons
Delete button is styled with destructive/danger variant
Dialog prevents action until user explicitly confirms
Dialog closes after action completes

requirements.text: Remove deleted media posts from UI immediately after successful deletion without requiring page refresh

quotes: UI se deleted items ko turant remove karna

acceptanceCriteria: Deleted post disappears from feed immediately
Deleted post disappears from profile page immediately
React Query cache is invalidated for affected queries
Success toast notification appears after deletion
No orphaned UI elements remain after deletion

requirements.text: Add delete mutation hook in useQueries.ts that calls the backend deletion method and handles loading/error states

quotes: Backend (Motoko) mein media deletion logic implement karunga

acceptanceCriteria: Mutation hook follows existing patterns in useQueries.ts
Hook handles loading state during deletion
Hook handles and displays error messages
Hook invalidates relevant queries on success
Hook returns mutation status for UI feedback

constraints: Do not modify the single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not edit immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
Maintain compatibility with existing blob storage system
Preserve admin controls and access permissions
nonGoals: Bulk delete functionality for multiple posts at once
Soft delete or trash/recycle bin features
